messages:
alex: Quick flag - noticed Go sampleapp raises typed `RateLimit` with `.RetryAfterSec`, but Ruby sample just surfaces a generic `APIError` and forces users to parse body. Breaks our parity promise and onboarding examples.

maya: Oof. Which endpoint? streaming chat or standard generate?

alex: Standard /v1/generate. Go example: `err.(*errors.RateLimit).RetryAfterSec == 2` works. Ruby: `raise APIError.new(resp.body)` -> no structured fields.

jordan: Can we standardize on an error envelope from the service and then normalize in SDKs? Envelope idea: `{"error": {"message": "...", "code": "rate_limit", "retry_after_ms": 2000, "retryable": true, "meta": {...}}}`.

ray: Yes to envelope. Two notes: 1) don't leak internal meta into `message` (short user-safe message only). 2) keep `code` stable (snake_case).

maya: For SDK behavior, I'd rather implement a small adapter that always returns an exception subclass tree: `APIError` -> `RateLimitError`, `AuthError`, etc. Adapter should accept legacy ways (plain text) so we don't break old clients.

alex: Agreed. Could be `errors.Normalize(resp) -> APIError`. Then SDKs can `raise Normalize(resp)` or return it from callbacks.

jordan: Streaming case: client libs should emit `on_finish(err, partial)` where `err` is normalized like above and `partial` is whatever tokens were delivered. That helps product teams show partial content and error together.

ray: Tests: we should add an e2e that exercises both legacy response bodies and new envelope bodies. CI should assert both produce the same exception class and attributes.

maya: I'll take Ruby adapter + docs snippet. Plan: add `Error.normalize(response, mode: :auto)` that handles legacy JSON, plaintext, and envelope. ETA Tue.

alex: I'll do Go and the sampleapp test harness. I'll also add `RetryAfterMs` and `Retryable` fields on the typed error. ETA Mon.

jordan: I'll update SDK error mapping doc and include the HTTP -> exception matrix (401 AuthError, 403 PermissionError, 404 NotFoundError, 409 ConflictError, 429 RateLimitError, 5xx ServerError). Also include guidance on `retry_after_ms` vs `retry_after` and prefer ms.

ray: Small product ask: add short copy for public docs showing how to catch by class and how to inspect `error.code` if people prefer that style. Keep examples in Node, Go, Ruby.

ci-bot: Created task INFR-1489: "SDK error-envelope + parity e2e (Go/Ruby)" assigned to alex,maya. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFR-1489

alex: One more implementation detail: don't change exception class identity for legacy flows in patch releases. Provide `normalize: true` opt-in flag in minor release, then flip default in next major. Avoid surprising semver bumps for customers.

maya: Noted. I'll add compatibility tests and a migration note in the changelog.

jordan: Nice. Once PRs land, I'll add the doc section "Error envelope & SDK normalization" with snippets and a tiny troubleshooting checklist for common fails.

ray: Sounds good. We'll review in SDK sync Thursday. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
